title: Chain 1 — one stage-inspection order from lead to profit: Mumbai sells, Ahmedabad inspects, with the same figures checked at every hand-over
persona: KEY_ACCOUNTS_MANAGER → BRANCH_MANAGER2 → FINANCE → BUSINESS_DIRECTOR → COORDINATOR2 → COORDINATOR → INSPECTOR (phone) → SR_INSPECTOR → BRANCH_MANAGER
why: This is the company's main money line. A number that changes between two screens, or a hand-over that drops the client, means a wrong price, a report that cannot be issued, a wrong GST type, revenue in the wrong office or a profit figure nobody can trust.
before: Test copy as delivered (batch 2, release 74a263f). Client TB Steel Works Pvt Ltd belongs to the Mumbai office. Before you start, as Test Finance or Master Admin, make sure of five things (on opstest these may not be set yet): (1) Directory → Clients → TB Steel Works Pvt Ltd → Addresses: Registered office 'Plot 12, Taloja MIDC, Navi Mumbai 410208', state Maharashtra; (2) the same client: GSTIN 27AAACT1234A1Z5, State Maharashtra, Credit days 45; (3) Directory → Vendors → + Add: 'EC Tank Fabricators Pvt Ltd', office Mumbai, address 'Plot 44, Taloja MIDC, Navi Mumbai', contact 'Sanjay Patil', 9820099999; (4) Money → Tally export → 'Ledger names & tax defaults' → Our state = Gujarat → Save (without it the invoice cannot know IGST from CGST+SGST — see EC-E2E-007); (5) Admin → Approvals → Report approver mapping: Test Inspector → Test SrInspector; both have a signature on file. Quotation approval levels as shipped: Level 1 Branch Manager ₹0–5,00,000, Level 2 Marketing Manager ₹5,00,000–25,00,000, Level 3 Business Director above.

finding: Cross-office chain breaks at four hand-overs: (a) report from a job executed for another office loses client and vendor and cannot be submitted (step 19); (b) next stage report starts a new series (step 24); (c) Billing-workspace draft for a Mumbai contract is raised in the Ahmedabad series with no contract and no credit days (steps 31–32), so Mumbai shows ₹0 revenue (step 37); (d) Ahmedabad managers are offered signatures on a Mumbai contract (step 12). Known: DEF-SAL-011 (step 11), DEF-FIN-009 (steps 35, 39), DEF-FLOW-008 (step 31), DEF-REP-006 (step 19 phone).
question: 1. Profit by work order shows SALARY ₹0 for a 2-day job by an inspector on ₹40,000 CTC: is salary cost only filled after the month-end cost run (Money → Office costs → close month)? If yes, the owner should run it before reading profit. 2. A job closed while its stage 2 witness point was still open, and visit days in the future could be closed: should either stop the close? (impact: billing before the client's witness point is cleared). 3. The work-order form shows 'Credit direction: Given (to the other office)' on the Ahmedabad side: which office gives and which receives the ₹3,600?

title: Break the chain — the accepted quotation is revised after the contract opened and the work order was raised: nothing downstream changes until the amendment is signed
why: A revision must not silently re-price work already ordered, and the contract must not drift from the quotation without the two signatures.
before: EC-E2E-001 done up to step 18 (contract MUM/C/2026-27/00001 open, CALL-00001 at ₹2,347.69 × 2 = ₹4,695.38, JOB-00001 allocated).

steps.do: Test KAM: Q-00001 → Actions → Revise (new rev) → summary 'Client added 6 more tanks' → Create revision.
steps.expect: 'Created revision 01 with 1 line(s) … Its costing MUM/PC/2026-27/11/0001 Rev 01 was made from … Rev 00 as a draft'. Rev 00 stays Accepted; Rev 01 is Draft and current.

steps.do: Edit Rev 01: quantity 24 → 48 man-days at the same ₹2,347.69; give the reason in 'Why the prices differ from the costing'; Save.
steps.expect: Total before tax ₹1,12,689.12 (48 × ₹2,347.69); GST ₹20,284.04; total ₹1,32,973.16. Actions now show Submit for approval (no longer 'No approval needed'), and '🔒 Locked — this quote has a contract'.

steps.do: Look at the costing shown on Rev 01, the contract, CALL-00001 and JOB-00001.
steps.expect: Contract MUM/C/2026-27/00001 still shows its old value and stays Open until an amendment is signed; CALL-00001 still ₹2,347.69 × 2 = ₹4,695.38; JOB-00001 value ₹4,695.38. The costing Rev 01 shows a figure that matches what the quotation now asks for, or says it must be changed in the Costing tab.

flow: Revision → costing Rev 01 → contract amendment (two signatures, docs/03 D-25) → only then new work orders at the new figures.
saw: Steps 1–2 exactly as written (₹1,12,689.12 / ₹20,284.04 / ₹1,32,973.16; Submit for approval; 'Locked — this quote has a contract'). Step 3: contract value ₹66,486.58 (incl. GST, DEF-SAL-011) and Open; CALL-00001 ₹2,347.69 / ₹4,695.38; JOB-00001 ₹4,695.38 — unchanged, as expected. The Rev 01 costing panel still reads 'revenue ₹56,344.56 · margin 28.6%' next to a quotation of ₹1,12,689.12.
question: Should costing Rev 01 follow the quotation's new quantity by itself, or must the salesperson change it in the Costing tab before Submit? (Impact: the approver sees a margin for 24 man-days on a 48-man-day quotation.)

title: Chain 6 — client portal: the client sees the issued reports, asks for a new inspection, Mumbai accepts and raises the work order, the client accepts one report and rejects the other
persona: client portal user (Meera Kulkarni, TB Steel Works) → COORDINATOR2 (Mumbai) → COORDINATOR (Ahmedabad)
why: What the client sees, asks and decides must land on the right office's desk with the right figures, and a rejection must start the quality loop.
before: EC-E2E-001 done up to step 29 (two reports issued for TB Steel Works). Client portal switched on; portal user meera.portal@ec-test.example for TB Steel Works with every right (company administrator).

steps.do: Sign in to the client portal as Meera. Look at the overview, then Reports.
steps.expect: Overview: '2 Reports Issued', recent activity lists both IRNs. Reports lists both, each with 'Accept or reject →', a verification code and Open PDF. Stage 2's title says stage 2 (it is a different report).

steps.do: Request an inspection: subject 'EC stage 3 inspection — tanks T-08 to T-12', 'Please inspect 5 tanks, stage 3, at Taloja', site Taloja MIDC, wanted in 5 days, contact Meera 9820012345 → Send it.
steps.expect: The request is saved (status New) and shows under the client's own requests.

steps.do: Test Coord (Ahmedabad) and Test Coord2 (Mumbai): Directory → Portals → Client portal → what clients have asked for.
steps.expect: Only Mumbai (TB Steel Works' office) sees the request (batch 2 point 11).

steps.do: Test Coord2: Accept & raise the call.
steps.expect: 'Request accepted and inspection call raised — complete the scheduling below.' CALL-0000x opens for Test Coord2 with client TB Steel Works, contracting office Mumbai, ready to pick the quote/contract MUM/C/2026-27/00001; the request shows Converted.

steps.do: Meera: Reports → stage 2 → Accept; stage 1 → Reject, reason 'Factual error', note 'Heat number of shell plate missing'.
steps.expect: Both decisions recorded with the history; the rejection raises a nonconformity automatically (source: client, minor).

steps.do: Test Coord (Ahmedabad, executing/issuing office) and Test Coord2 (Mumbai): Quality → Client acceptance.
steps.expect: The office that issued the report sees '1 REJECTED, NOT ACKNOWLEDGED' and 'Issued, no answer yet (0)'; the contracting office sees it too (it holds the client).

flow: Issued reports → portal list → client decision → Client acceptance register → automatic NCR → quality loop (EC-E2E-015); portal request → work order → job.
basis: lib/portal*.php; QA-REPORTS/V51/27 P5 (hold check) and V51/30 points 11–12; docs/03 Inspection report.
saw: Step 1 as written, except both reports carry the same title 'EC Stage 1 — shell plates and nozzles' (the next-stage copy keeps stage 1's title). Step 2: request saved (portal_requests status NEW); the client's requests page did not show it to the robot. Step 3: only Test Coord2 sees it — as expected. Step 4: 'Request accepted and inspection call raised …' followed at once by 'This inspection call is outside your office / branch scope.' CALL-00002 was created with NO contracting office, NO executing office, no contract, no quote and ₹0; the request is Converted. Step 5: reviews stored (stage 2 ACCEPTED, stage 1 REJECTED 'FACTUAL'), automatic NCR-2026-0001 source CLIENT, minor, job JOB-00001, client TB Steel Works, office Ahmedabad. Step 6: Ahmedabad '1 REJECTED, NOT ACKNOWLEDGED'; Mumbai '0'.
finding: A work order raised from a portal request has no office, so the coordinator who raised it is locked out of it.
question: Should the contracting office (Mumbai, which holds the client) also see the client's rejection on Client acceptance? Should a next-stage report get its own title ('Stage 2') instead of copying stage 1's?
